species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 60 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 51°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 10–34 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 40 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 60 ft, so fish stay above it.
Northwest wind at 13 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
